items.title: Mike Evans: Still limited to side work
items.text:
Evans (ribs/Achilles) was working off to the side during the opening portion of Saturday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Mike Evans: Questionable for MNF
items.text:

items.title: A.J. Brown: Activated from injured reserve
items.text:
